name: Polymeric Coatings
description: General introduction, basic coating formulations, different material classes-alkyds and polyesters, polyurethanes, epoxy, acrylates etc., additives and particulates, application methods – conventional deposition techniques, laboratory and industrial methods - doctorblade coating, spin coating and dip coating, powder coating, automotive coatings, surface preparation techniques, mechanism of adhesion of polymeric coatings on various substrates, electrodeposition, physical chemical aspects – intermolecular and mesoscopic interactions, interfacial aspects, dispersions, emulsions, self-assembly, selection criteria for various substrates. Antifouling coatings, biofoulants, high temperature coatings, self-replenishing and self-healing coatings, superhydrophilic, superhydrophobic and omniphobic coatings, environmental safety and health hazards.
